## Strategy B / bounded source contract

Stacked on successful physical route A exact HEAD `7aac3e73828895a646671ce2874c701e7f1e9594` without touching main, A evidence, S49 Action/S16, S50 full Node TRACE_END parser, P1/M/L8 owners. **Only offline tests, no real next L0 World run yet.**

The existing S50 packet/Body validator requires a complete Node sidecar sealed on shutdown. Never weaken its `TRACE_END`. The new DEV-only `s50_live_paper_window.py` instead captures an exact newline-terminated *Paper log byte prefix* while Java is still live, requiring original PRE/POST phase, WAIT_BEGIN, consecutive 8 WAIT and 8 INPUT samples, marker/subject/World and bounded SHA+size. Explicit `PROVISIONAL_PAPER_ONLY`; never claims complete Node source, synchronized clock, full-tick idle, stable body, Goal or P1 WAIT. Independent post-shutdown byte-prefix match against final Paper original only; complete S50 Node/footer original remains a separate required final owner audit.

New `self_body_s50_live_next_epoch.py` pairs one original typed previous S16/native SelfBody view and that provisional Paper-only window with **one subsequent original same-session S49 `live_probe`**, strictly newer event/native seq, and produces fresh current Body/World Present from that *new* native probe alone. Past Paper motion is read as prior tentative evidence **inside the pre-L0 observer**, not promoted to native Present or L0 Action policy. Duplicate/replay/foreign input revokes without vetoing L0. No new issuer/probe/Model/Memory/M/P1/L8/L10/S10/S11.

Includes focused synthetic tests and CI. **Critical remaining physical gap**: the existing single-Action L23 runner has only initial WAIT -> MOVE and no third, post-Action L0 event. It must be extended in a controlled, separate LocalCodex DEV worktree to record one original post-Action WAIT L0 event while server remains running; a manually added diagnostic probe is NOT a real L0 epoch. No live route B PASS claimed. Detailed [owner handoff](https://github.com/rinsakamo/relay-self/blob/dev/selfbody-s50-live-paper-window-20261031/docs/selfbody-s50-live-next-epoch-dev-20261031.md).

DEV_ONLY / OFFLINE_B_SOURCE_CONTRACT / REAL_NEXT_NATIVE_L0_NOT_RUN / QUALIFICATION_NO_GO / SCIENCE_NOT_RUN.
